en.title: Manual Target Adjustments
en.excerpt: How to customize lane positions, swap archers between butts, and accommodate left-handed or para-athletes.

toc.text: Swapping Archers via the Grid Interface
Saving and Locking the Target Grid

en.content:
Special Accommodations

Manual adjustments are often required to accommodate specific athlete needs:

  • Left-Handed Archers: Placing left-handed shooters in Position A or C (left side of the butt) to prevent elbow clashes with right-handed archers.
  • Wheelchair & Para-Athletes: Assigning lower-numbered target butts nearest to venue ramps and access paths.

Swapping Archers via the Grid Interface

On the Target Allocation Grid view, click on any assigned athlete card. A modal appears allowing you to select any other athlete card to swap their positions instantly, or move the athlete into an empty position.

Managing Empty Target Slots

If a category has 14 archers on 4 target butts, the system leaves positions 4C and 4D empty. Scorekeeper tablets automatically adjust their keypad sequence to skip empty letters.

Saving and Locking the Target Grid

Once adjustments are complete, click Lock Target Layout to sync assignments to athlete dashboards and scorekeeper mobile portals.
